_comment: Approved background clips (owner-picked on Pexels, checked frame by frame by Claude: no people, no writing or calligraphy, no logos, no commercial towers). Stored on Cloudinary already cropped to 1080x1920 and brand-graded. Only clips listed here can ever appear in a Reel. Owner decision 2026-10-09: recognisable, universally revered mosques are allowed. pool: mosqueN = mosque at night/dusk, skyN = night/blue-hour sky, dusk = sunset/dusk nature, mosqueD = mosque in daylight, day = daytime nature. 7311579-a removed 2026-10-10 (a structure at the left edge shows when the clip is slowed). 2026-10-11: added 12279775 (dawn), 39003563 (skyN), 39553996 (rain), 38321872 (dusk, trimmed 0-8 s, as 38321872-b); new pools dawn = sunrise / first light, rain = rain clouds. 2026-10-12: Coverr clips (official API, checked by eye on scout run 38207788918 and the vertical crops) in their own pools cNight, cDusk, cDawn, cSun, cLight, cGold, cClouds, cSea: only an explicit FOOTAGE_ARC uses them, never the Khatm arc. 2026-10-13: +20 Coverr clips (scout run 38329781912, checked by eye on sheets and vertical crops) in new pools seaNight, sea, falls, stream, valley, lake, skyDusk, snow; only an explicit FOOTAGE_ARC uses them. 2026-10-13 (later): +16 Coverr clips (retry after the API hourly limit, crops checked by eye) in pools falls, snow, forest, leaves, sky, skyN, desert, field, birds; 39 (misty forest) left out: a line through the mist.
